notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

At last this game now offers full controller support for Xbox controllers.
For more information, please check the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/431220/discussions/1/365163686043599640/]Controller FAQs[/url].

With this last update, unfortunately I also removed the Linear Filtering due to some graphical instabilities on some users' PCs. But support to Linear Filtering may be added in the future.

Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you!

Kind regards,
Alysson L. Neto

notes.title: Porradaria 2: PotN Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

These are the changes and bug fixes of this first update (and last, I hope).

[list]
[*]Game crash when killing a Samurai/Archer;
[*]Odd behavior from some enemies when the Ninja is using his [b]Ultimate Magic[/b] (Dark Scroll).
[*]Added linear filtering, graphics will look smother.
[*]*[strike]Added full controller support to SteamOS+Linux.[/strike]
[*]*Added full support to modern game pads for Windows (i.e: Xbox 360 controller).
[/list]

*These features were not fully tested yet, please report to the forums if you find any trouble with these.

Thanks for your ever support, my work is for you!

Kind regards,
Alysson L. Neto
